findings.reason: Wrong state, and it contradicts the same namespace. src/renderer/src/features/chat/components/run-details/run-detail-model.ts todoClause() returns this string when counts.droppedTodos > 0 and counts.openTodos === 0 — the plan is settled and AT LEAST ONE item was dropped; the docblock above it explicitly keeps dropped beside the fraction for exactly that reason. 取消 is this namespace's word for 'dropped' (todos.dropped = ——已取消, rendered as the inline settled tag), so 待办已全部取消 tells the reader every item was cancelled even when most were completed, and the chip then reads the same as the dropped tag it sits beside. 结束 keeps the neutral settled reading next to 待办已全部解决 ('All to-dos resolved'); 待办已全部关闭 is the alternative if the pane prefers the 关闭 family.
